tagline: Magnetically steered Magnetospirillum magneticum carrying a heat-triggered therapeutic, with RiboTherm, an MCMC optimiser for RNA thermometers.
tagline_zh: 以磁場導引的 Magnetospirillum magneticum 攜帶熱觸發的治療分子，並搭配 RiboTherm，一套用於 RNA 溫度計的 MCMC 最佳化工具。
summary: MagNav uses Magnetospirillum magneticum AMB-1, a magnetotactic bacterium that follows external magnetic fields and thrives in low-oxygen environments, as a vector for delivering ClyA into ovarian cancer and endometriotic tissue. Alternating magnetic fields generate heat inside the bacteria, which induces therapeutic expression through a sigma-32 heat shock promoter; because heat shock promoters leak and imprecise expression would damage healthy tissue, the team added an RNA thermometer in the 5' UTR that folds to sequester the Shine-Dalgarno sequence and physically block ribosome binding until the temperature rises. The dry lab built RiboTherm to redesign that thermometer: an open-source Python package that searches 32 designable positions with a Metropolis-Hastings MCMC sampler against a two-term objective combining a ddG-open switching score with a novel Jensen-Shannon ensemble regulariser that keeps the 37 degree C silent state close to the parent. Three designs went to the bench, one (M1) held basal expression below the Neupert U8 parent while still responding at 45 degree C, and the team reports the rest of the comparison with explicit caveats about a single unreplicated blot.
summary_zh: MagNav 以 Magnetospirillum magneticum AMB-1 作為載體，把 ClyA 遞送到卵巢癌與子宮內膜異位組織；這是一種會循外加磁場移動、且在低氧環境中生長良好的磁趨性細菌。交流磁場在細菌體內產生熱，透過 sigma-32 熱休克啟動子誘導治療蛋白表現；由於熱休克啟動子會滲漏，而表現不精準會傷害健康組織，團隊在 5' UTR 加入一個 RNA 溫度計，使其摺疊後把 Shine-Dalgarno 序列包藏起來，在溫度上升之前以物理方式阻擋核糖體結合。乾實驗打造 RiboTherm 來重新設計這個溫度計：一個開源的 Python 套件，以 Metropolis-Hastings MCMC 取樣器在 32 個可設計位置上搜尋，目標函數由兩項構成，結合 ddG-open 的切換分數與一個新提出的 Jensen-Shannon 系集正則化項，後者讓 37 度 C 的靜默狀態保持接近母序列。三個設計進入實驗驗證，其中 M1 的基礎表現低於 Neupert U8 母序列，同時仍能在 45 度 C 下反應；團隊報告其餘比較結果時，明確加上「只有單一次、未重複的墨點」這項保留。
awards: Best New Improved Part winner, Undergraduate

dry.frameworks: RiboTherm is a standalone open-source Python package built on ViennaRNA (RNAfold/RNAheat and base-pair probability matrices) and distributed as a 30 KB ZIP from the wiki at https://2026.igem.wiki/michigan/downloads/rnatherm-design-main.zip, with installation, directory layout, CLI and a worked example in the repository README. A design campaign is specified entirely in one YAML file, and the package's architecture keeps four things declared independently so any one can be swapped without touching the others: the construct and which positions may mutate, the feature functions that score a candidate, the objective weights that combine them, and the sampler. The team is explicit that their own scientific contribution sits only in the middle two, and that a new feature is registered as a function taking the folded ensemble, the temperatures and a window and returning a number. Each run writes a copy of its own configuration alongside one trajectory file per chain, and stores both feature values rather than only the combined objective, so a campaign can be re-scored at a different lambda without re-folding anything. Null-distribution comparison and final design selection are deliberately left outside the package. No hosted web deployment; wiki repo at https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/michigan.
dry.frameworks_zh: RiboTherm 是一個獨立的開源 Python 套件，建立在 ViennaRNA 之上（RNAfold/RNAheat 與鹼基配對機率矩陣），並以 30 KB 的 ZIP 從 wiki 發布（https://2026.igem.wiki/michigan/downloads/rnatherm-design-main.zip），安裝方式、目錄結構、CLI 與一個完整範例都寫在 repository 的 README 裡。一次設計運算完全由單一 YAML 檔指定，而套件的架構讓四件事各自獨立宣告，因此任何一項都能替換而不必動到其他三項：構築體與可突變的位置、為候選序列評分的特徵函數、把它們組合起來的目標權重，以及取樣器。團隊明確指出自己的科學貢獻只落在中間那兩項，而新的特徵是以一個函數註冊，該函數接收摺疊後的系集、溫度與視窗，並回傳一個數字。每次執行都會把自己的組態複製一份寫出，並為每條鏈各寫一個軌跡檔，且同時儲存兩項特徵值而非只存合併後的目標值，因此一次運算可以在不同的 lambda 下重新評分，完全不必重新摺疊。虛無分布的比較與最終設計的挑選則刻意留在套件之外。沒有架設網頁服務；wiki 的 repository 位於 https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/michigan。
dry.dataviz: The model page is written as a methods paper and figures carry that weight: minimum-free-energy structures of the Neupert U1-U10 thermometers with SD, spacer and start codon colour-coded by role; heat-capacity curves computed with RNAheat plus a two-state test across the Sen et al. library; the correlation between ddG-open and measured fold change as a function of the scoring window half-width; a context-length convergence plot shown on a log scale with and without the base-pair span cap, alongside a full context-by-context pairwise divergence matrix; the Pareto front with 5,000 grey null sequences behind the four design campaigns shaded light to dark by lambda and the three selected designs marked; a figure explaining how a YAML campaign is specified and what it produces; MFE structures of the three designs against the parent with black rings on mutated positions; and the western blot. Every figure caption states what the figure does and does not support.
dry.dataviz_zh: 模型頁面是以方法論文的方式撰寫，圖表也承擔了相應的重量：Neupert U1-U10 溫度計的最小自由能結構，SD、間隔區與起始密碼子依角色上色；以 RNAheat 計算的熱容曲線，加上在 Sen 等人序列庫上的雙態檢驗；ddG-open 與實測倍數變化之間的相關性如何隨評分視窗半寬而變；以對數尺度呈現、分別有與沒有鹼基配對跨距上限的上下文長度收斂圖，旁邊附上完整的上下文對上下文兩兩散度矩陣；Pareto 前沿圖，後方是 5,000 條灰色虛無序列，四次設計運算依 lambda 由淺至深著色，三個被選中的設計都有標示；一張說明 YAML 運算如何指定、以及它產出什麼的圖；三個設計與母序列的 MFE 結構對照，突變位置以黑圈標出；以及那張西方墨點圖。每一張圖說都寫明這張圖支持什麼、不支持什麼。
dry.datascience: The design space is roughly 4^32, about 2 x 10^19 sequences, which the team notes would take about a year to enumerate even parallelised, so they used a Metropolis-Hastings MCMC optimiser with single-nucleotide uniform proposals. Four campaigns of eight independent chains at 20,000 moves each gave 640,000 scored proposals, 391,835 of them unique. A 5,000-sequence null distribution was built first to calibrate hyperparameters, and it revealed that the two objective terms sit on completely different scales: random sequences score about 0.91 on JS-mean against the parent's 0.0095, nearly two orders of magnitude apart, while ddG-open spans only about +0.5 to -1.8 kcal/mol against the parent's -1.33, with only about 3% of random sequences beating the parent at all. The selection rule was fixed before any results were inspected: beat U8+2GC on ddG-open, then rank by lowest JS-mean. The headline number is published plainly: 335,408 sequences beat the parent on switching, but only 28 of those also beat it on ensemble similarity, which the team presents as the clearest statement of how sharp the Pareto front is. They connect that front to published theory, noting that recent work finds threshold temperature inversely proportional to peak sensitivity in two-state models and that the tradeoff survives in multi-state and branched models. Two methodological choices are documented with their justification. First, the base-pair span is capped at 150 nt throughout, because ViennaRNA's predictions become unreliable beyond roughly 100-200 nt, and applying the cap is what makes truncation defensible: with it, the windowed ensemble converges to 0.0095 at 100 nt of flanking context, while without it the metric never converges, staying between 0.024 and 0.048 at every length because unpredictable long-range pairs keep reshuffling the ensemble. Second, the reference pairing vectors are computed once from the full 1,189 nt construct folded at 37 degree C, not from the truncated layout the sampler scores on, and the team flags this as the detail easiest to get wrong on reimplementation. They also publish an accessibility check that was never used in selection, P(SD unpaired) at 42 over 37 degree C, where all three designs improve on the parent's 1.95x (M1 3.03x, M2 4.78x, M3 4.33x). Limits on the incoming data are stated too: the Sen et al. library used for fitting was measured in a cell-free E. coli extract with no membrane, no chromosomal transcription and a different ribosome and RNase load, so transferring it to living AMB-1 is named as the largest untested assumption carried by the model.
dry.datascience_zh: 設計空間約為 4^32，大約 2 x 10^19 條序列；團隊指出即使平行化，完整列舉也要大約一年，因此他們改用以單核苷酸均勻提議的 Metropolis-Hastings MCMC 最佳化器。四次運算、每次八條獨立鏈、每條鏈 20,000 步，共得到 640,000 個被評分的提議，其中 391,835 個互異。他們先建立一個 5,000 條序列的虛無分布來校正超參數，而這也揭露兩個目標項的尺度完全不同：隨機序列的 JS 平均值約為 0.91，母序列則為 0.0095，相差將近兩個數量級；ddG-open 只橫跨約 +0.5 到 -1.8 kcal/mol，母序列為 -1.33，而隨機序列中只有約 3% 能勝過母序列。篩選規則在檢視任何結果之前就先固定：先在 ddG-open 上勝過 U8+2GC，再依 JS 平均值由低到高排序。主要數字被直白公布：335,408 條序列在切換性上勝過母序列，但其中只有 28 條同時在系集相似度上也勝過它；團隊把這當作對 Pareto 前沿有多陡最清楚的陳述。他們也把這條前沿連回已發表的理論，指出近期研究發現在雙態模型中閾值溫度與峰值靈敏度成反比，而這項取捨在多態與分支模型中依然存在。兩項方法選擇都連同理由記錄下來。第一，鹼基配對跨距全程上限為 150 nt，因為 ViennaRNA 的預測在大約 100-200 nt 之外就不再可靠，而套上這個上限正是截斷之所以站得住腳的原因：有上限時，視窗內的系集在 100 nt 的側翼上下文處收斂到 0.0095；沒有上限時，這個指標從不收斂，在每個長度都停留在 0.024 到 0.048 之間，因為無法預測的長程配對不斷把系集重新洗牌。第二，參考配對向量只計算一次，由完整的 1,189 nt 構築體在 37 度 C 下摺疊得到，而不是取樣器實際評分所用的截斷版本；團隊特別標示這是重新實作時最容易弄錯的細節。他們也公布了一項從未用於挑選的可及性檢查：42 度 C 對 37 度 C 的 P(SD 未配對) 比值，三個設計都勝過母序列的 1.95 倍（M1 為 3.03 倍、M2 為 4.78 倍、M3 為 4.33 倍）。輸入資料的限制同樣寫明：用於擬合的 Sen 等人序列庫是在無細胞的 E. coli 萃取液中量測，沒有膜、沒有染色體轉錄，核糖體與 RNase 的負荷也不同，因此把它移轉到活的 AMB-1 上，被指名為這個模型所承載的最大未經檢驗假設。
dry.software: The interesting engineering contribution is the Jensen-Shannon ensemble regulariser, which answers a different question from standard RNA inverse design. Rather than asking whether two sequences share a single most stable structure, it fixes a 30-nucleotide window centred on the Shine-Dalgarno sequence, reads each position's in-window pairing-partner distribution off the base-pair probability matrix, renormalises it to a probability distribution (assigning a uniform distribution where in-window pairing probability is negligible rather than leaving it undefined), and takes the mean Jensen-Shannon divergence against the reference. JS was chosen over KL because it is symmetric, always finite even where one distribution puts no weight, zero for identical distributions and bounded above by one bit. The consequence is visible in the results: all three designs fold to an identical MFE structure at both 37 and 42 degree C, so their predicted switching comes entirely from reweighting within the ensemble rather than from a change in the single most stable fold, and the team notes that inverse-design methods matching MFE structures at two temperatures cannot produce these sequences by construction. The structural finding is also reported: all three designs leave the anti-SD, loop and spacer at wild type and remodel only the anti-spacer, a pattern that held across the entire low-JS candidate set, suggesting the other elements of U8+2GC are already near-optimal for this scaffold. M2 is reported as the best-supported design in the sweep, independently rediscovered by two chains under both lambda = 5 and lambda = 10 and visited 45 times. The limits are listed without hedging: the package relies on ViennaRNA equilibrium thermodynamics so anything kinetically controlled is out of reach; it searches by single-nucleotide substitution only so insertions and deletions, including a changed stem length, are unreachable by construction, which the team notes is a real restriction given that the two most differently behaved thermometers in the Sen library differ by a single deletion; it needs a new reference ensemble per construct; runs are not resumable; and a design question involving several interacting switches or a target that cannot be written as a number is out of scope. Three things are named as what must change to apply it elsewhere (rewrite the construct block and rebuild the reference, set the temperatures and base-pair span for the new regime, re-tune the sampler temperature because lambda rescales the objective and the acceptance behaviour with it), with lambda = 0 offered as a pure ddG-open search for systems with no silent reference. The wet-lab validation is reported with unusual restraint: a single western blot without a loading control or replicates, induced at 45 degree C rather than the 42 degree C the designs were optimised for, so only a qualitative ordering is claimed and none of the predicted fold changes can be checked. M3 gave no detectable band in any lane including the 30 degree C control and is read as a construct that did not express, which the team notes cost them the one clean test of the regulariser, since M2 and M3 were matched on ddG-open (-1.851 vs -1.830) and differed mainly in JS-mean (0.0204 vs 0.0166) at only four positions. Of the two results they do claim, the second is qualified as 'an observation rather than evidence' because with n = 2 and a qualitative readout coincidence cannot be excluded. AI use is disclosed: Claude Code helped create the wiki figures and scaffolded much of the RiboTherm code, with all output reviewed before implementation.
dry.software_zh: 最有意思的工程貢獻是 Jensen-Shannon 系集正則化項，它回答的問題與標準的 RNA 逆向設計不同。它不問兩條序列是否共用同一個最穩定結構，而是固定一個以 Shine-Dalgarno 序列為中心、寬 30 個核苷酸的視窗，從鹼基配對機率矩陣讀出每個位置在視窗內的配對對象分布，再把它重新正規化成機率分布（在視窗內配對機率可忽略之處指派均勻分布，而不是讓它未定義），然後取相對於參考的 Jensen-Shannon 散度平均值。選用 JS 而非 KL 的理由是：它對稱、即使其中一個分布在某處完全沒有權重也始終有限、對相同分布為 0，且上界為 1 bit。這個選擇的後果在結果中看得見：三個設計在 37 度 C 與 42 度 C 下都摺疊成完全相同的 MFE 結構，因此它們被預測的切換行為完全來自系集內部的權重重分配，而不是最穩定摺疊構型的改變；團隊並指出，在兩個溫度下以匹配 MFE 結構為目標的逆向設計方法，在設計原理上根本不可能產生這些序列。結構上的發現也一併報告：三個設計都讓 anti-SD、環區與間隔區維持野生型，只重塑 anti-spacer，而這個模式在整個低 JS 候選集合中一致出現，顯示 U8+2GC 的其他元件對這個骨架而言已接近最佳。M2 被報告為整次搜尋中證據最充分的設計，在 lambda = 5 與 lambda = 10 兩種設定下都被兩條鏈獨立重新找到，並被造訪 45 次。限制則毫不迴避地列出：套件依賴 ViennaRNA 的平衡熱力學，因此任何受動力學控制的現象都無法觸及；它只以單核苷酸置換搜尋，所以插入與刪除（包括改變莖長）在設計原理上就無法到達，而團隊指出這是一項真實的限制，因為 Sen 序列庫中行為差異最大的兩個溫度計正好只差一個刪除；它對每個構築體都需要一份新的參考系集；執行過程無法續跑；而涉及多個交互作用開關、或目標無法寫成一個數字的設計問題，則不在適用範圍內。要把它套用到別處，必須改變的三件事被明確點名（改寫 construct 區塊並重建參考、為新的條件設定溫度與鹼基配對跨距、重新調校取樣器溫度，因為 lambda 會把目標函數連同接受行為一起重新縮放），並提供 lambda = 0 作為純 ddG-open 搜尋，供沒有靜默參考的系統使用。濕實驗驗證以罕見的節制來報告：只有一次西方墨點，沒有上樣對照也沒有重複，而且是在 45 度 C 下誘導，但設計最佳化的目標溫度是 42 度 C，因此只主張定性的排序，所有被預測的倍數變化都無法檢核。M3 在包括 30 度 C 對照在內的每一道都沒有可偵測的條帶，被判讀為一個沒有表現的構築體；團隊指出這讓他們失去唯一一次對正則化項的乾淨檢驗，因為 M2 與 M3 在 ddG-open 上相當（-1.851 對 -1.830），主要差異在 JS 平均值（0.0204 對 0.0166），且只差四個位置。他們確實主張的兩項結果中，第二項被限定為「一項觀察而非證據」，因為在 n = 2 且讀值為定性的情況下，無法排除巧合。AI 使用也有揭露：Claude Code 協助製作 wiki 圖表，並為 RiboTherm 的大部分程式碼搭起骨架，所有產出在實作前都經過審閱。
techniques: custom two-term objective with weighted regularisation
Jensen-Shannon divergence over per-position base-pair-probability distributions
ddG-open ensemble free-energy difference between temperatures
partition-function and heat-capacity (Cp) based melting-temperature estimation
synthetic melt curves from base-pair probability matrices
null distribution construction for hyperparameter calibration
base-pair span capping for folding-model reliability

good.publicEngagement: MSBTalks is a multimedia podcast series of recorded in-person and Zoom conversations with experts across synthetic biology, cancer biology, reproductive health, microbiology, chemical engineering and biophysics, published on the team's YouTube channel. The stated motive is unusual: the team modelled the episodes on office-hours conversations and published them specifically to show students what approaching an expert looks like, because they knew from their own experience how much nervousness precedes those meetings. Additional accessible outputs include a pre-printed manuscript, a videogame and a physical modeling kit.
good.publicEngagement_zh: MSBTalks 是一個多媒體播客系列，收錄與合成生物學、癌症生物學、生殖健康、微生物學、化學工程與生物物理學各領域專家的實體與 Zoom 對談，發布在團隊的 YouTube 頻道。其動機並不常見：團隊是以教授 office hours 的對話為原型來設計每一集，並特意公開，目的是讓學生看見主動接觸專家實際上是什麼樣子，因為他們從自身經驗知道這類會面之前有多緊張。其他可取用的產出還包括一份預印稿、一款電玩遊戲與一套實體建模套件。
good.ihp: Human practices was framed around the fact that live-bacteria therapeutics attract scrutiny because bacteria are associated with contamination and infection rather than benefit, so the team worked through the bioethical considerations and then tested MagNav's framing with stakeholders. Expert conversations changed specific things. Dr. Costas Lyssiotis (Maisel Professor of Oncology, Michigan) agreed that localisation and specificity were the most important goal, told them the novelty of magnetically guided treatment meant AMB-1's magnetotaxis would need thorough characterisation, and told them to spell out why injecting AMB-1 near a tumour would not cause infection or sepsis; he also pushed them to hold the wiki to publication standards. Dr. Nicole Koropatkin (Microbiology and Immunology, Michigan) advised fusing synthetic surface proteins to small native proteins already known to localise where needed, and on working with a strain like AMB-1 that resists standard transformation. Dr. Geoffrey Greene (Ben May Department for Cancer Research, Chicago) endorsed the two-step targeting approach of hypoxia plus folate-receptor-alpha binding because combining two steps reduces off-target effects, and was sceptical of selective estrogen receptor degraders.
good.ihp_zh: 整合式人類實踐的框架建立在一個事實上：活菌療法之所以招來審視，是因為細菌讓人聯想到污染與感染而非益處；因此團隊先梳理生物倫理上的考量，再把 MagNav 的論述框架拿去與利害關係人檢驗。專家對談改變了具體的事。Dr. Costas Lyssiotis（密西根大學 Maisel 腫瘤學講座教授）同意局部定位與專一性是最重要的目標，並告訴他們磁場導引治療的新穎性意味著 AMB-1 的磁趨性需要徹底的特性分析，也要他們寫清楚為什麼在腫瘤附近注射 AMB-1 不會造成感染或敗血症；他同時督促他們把 wiki 做到可發表的水準。Dr. Nicole Koropatkin（密西根大學微生物與免疫學）建議把合成的表面蛋白融合到已知會定位至所需位置的小型原生蛋白上，並就如何操作像 AMB-1 這類抗拒標準轉形程序的菌株提供意見。Dr. Geoffrey Greene（芝加哥大學 Ben May 癌症研究部）支持低氧加上葉酸受體 alpha 結合的兩段式標靶策略，因為結合兩道步驟可降低非目標效應，但他對選擇性雌激素受體降解劑持懷疑態度。
good.realWorld: The problem is framed with cited figures: over 21,000 estimated new US ovarian cancer diagnoses in 2026, a 52% five-year relative survival rate for 2016-2022, 190 million reproductive-aged women affected by endometriosis worldwide, and an average 6.7-year endometriosis diagnostic delay for patients aged 18-45. MagNav is positioned as a modular and more precise alternative or addition to existing standards of care rather than a replacement, potentially usable alongside existing medication and surgery, and the team notes that novel therapies take years to become accessible. The customisable framework is presented as extensible to other cancers and reproductive diseases by changing the payload and targeting ligand.
good.realWorld_zh: 問題的框架附有引用數字：2026 年美國估計超過 21,000 例新確診卵巢癌、2016-2022 年的五年相對存活率為 52%、全球有 1.9 億名生育年齡女性受子宮內膜異位症影響，以及 18-45 歲患者平均 6.7 年的子宮內膜異位症確診延遲。MagNav 被定位為現行標準治療的模組化、更精準的替代或補充方案，而不是取代，可能與現有藥物與手術並用；團隊也指出新療法要變得可及需要數年。這套可客製化的框架被呈現為可延伸到其他癌症與生殖疾病，只需更換負載與標靶配體。

images.caption: The Pareto front between switching (ddG-open) and basal expression (JS-mean): 5,000 grey null sequences behind four design campaigns shaded by lambda, with the three selected designs marked on the low-JS end.
images.caption_zh: 切換性（ddG-open）與基礎表現（JS 平均值）之間的 Pareto 前沿：5,000 條灰色虛無序列在後，四次設計運算依 lambda 著色，三個被選中的設計標示在低 JS 的一端。

images.caption: How a RiboTherm design campaign is specified: one YAML file declaring construct, features, objective weights and sampler independently, running eight chains and writing both feature values so a campaign can be re-scored without re-folding.
images.caption_zh: 一次 RiboTherm 設計運算如何指定：單一 YAML 檔各自獨立宣告構築體、特徵、目標權重與取樣器，執行八條鏈，並同時寫出兩項特徵值，使運算可在不重新摺疊的情況下重新評分。

images.caption: Choosing how much sequence context to fold: with the base-pair span capped at 150 nt the windowed ensemble converges by 100 nt of flanking context, while without the cap it never converges.
images.caption_zh: 要摺疊多少序列上下文：把鹼基配對跨距上限設為 150 nt 時，視窗內的系集在 100 nt 的側翼上下文處即收斂；沒有這個上限則永不收斂。

images.caption: Western blot against ClyA for the three RiboTherm designs and the two reference constructs, a single run without a loading control or replicates, with M3 giving no detectable band in any lane.
images.caption_zh: 針對三個 RiboTherm 設計與兩個參考構築體、以 ClyA 為標的的西方墨點，單一次執行，沒有上樣對照也沒有重複，其中 M3 在任何一道都沒有可偵測的條帶。

gemsTakeaway: Fix the selection rule before looking at any results, then publish the number that shows how hard the problem is: 335,408 of 391,835 sequences beat the parent on switching but only 28 also beat it on ensemble similarity, which turns an optimisation run into a statement about the design space rather than a list of winners. Also copy their habit of justifying a computational shortcut by showing what happens without it, as with the 150 nt base-pair span cap that is the only reason truncated folding converges at all.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 在看到任何結果之前就先把篩選規則定下來，然後公布那個能顯示問題有多難的數字：391,835 條序列中有 335,408 條在切換性上勝過母序列，但其中只有 28 條同時在系集相似度上也勝過它，這讓一次最佳化運算從一份贏家名單變成一項關於設計空間的陳述。同樣值得照做的是他們為計算捷徑提出理由的習慣：直接展示不用它會發生什麼事，就像 150 nt 的鹼基配對跨距上限，那正是截斷後的摺疊計算之所以能收斂的唯一原因。
